observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat >> config/runtime/base.vars <<'EOF'

# OIDC auth config (non-secret). Required by the app's auth config resolution
# (getAuthConfig) even on the mock-auth local-builder profile, because /auth/me
# and /api/v1/iam/me/context resolve the request scope before the mock short-circuit.
SVA_AUTH_ISSUER=http://127.0.0.1:8081/realms/sva-studio
SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio
SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3000/
EOF
echo "added auth config"
echo "=== registered studio task identifiers (any cron?) ==="
grep -rn "cron\|registerTask\|taskIdentifier\s*=" packages/auth-runtime/src/plugin-operations/runner-registry.ts | grep -iE "cron|studioJob|plugin" | head
